moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially starts this Friday, August 21st, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Kick-off Excitement
angles.copy: The wait is over! The Premier League is BACK this Friday. Who are you backing for the title this season?

angles.name: Arsenal vs Coventry
angles.copy: London's Arsenal kick off the new Premier League season at home against Coventry City on Friday. Can the Gunners defend their title?

moments.title: EFL Championship Action Continues
moments.blurb: The EFL Championship, League One, and League Two seasons are now fully underway, with Sky Sports broadcasting extensive live coverage of matches across the divisions.

angles.name: Championship Buzz

angles.name: Welsh Teams in EFL

moments.title: The Weeknd Continues Wembley Stadium Residency
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his 'After Hours Til Dawn' stadium tour to Wembley Stadium tonight, August 18th, and tomorrow, August 19th, for two more massive London dates.

angles.name: After Hours Til Dawn
angles.copy: The Weeknd's 'After Hours Til Dawn' tour continues its London takeover. What's the one song you HAVE to hear live?

moments.title: Ariana Grande's 'Eternal Sunshine' at The O2
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande continues her ten-night 'Eternal Sunshine' residency at London's The O2 this week, with shows on August 19, 20, 23, 24, 27, 28, and 31.

angles.name: Ariana O2 Dates
angles.copy: More chances to catch Ariana Grande at The O2 this week! Who's got tickets to her 'Eternal Sunshine' residency?

angles.name: London Pop Princess

moments.title: All Points East Festival Kicks Off in London

angles.name: Festival Vibes

moments.title: Green Man Festival Returns to Wales

angles.copy: Wales' iconic Green Man Festival is back from Thursday! Expect amazing music, arts, and that unique Welsh festival atmosphere.

moments.title: REWIND Festival South for 80s & 90s Classics

angles.name: Classic Festival
angles.copy: Dust off your neon and get ready to dance! REWIND Festival South celebrates the best of the 80s and 90s this weekend in Henley.

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Hold UK No. 1 Spot
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at No. 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart (August 13-19), with Shakira & Burna Boy at #2 and Ella Langley at #3. Madonna & Kylie Minogue enter at #8 with 'Love Sensation'.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Still at No. 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are holding strong on the Official Singles Chart. What's your favourite from the Top 10?

angles.name: New Entry Icons
angles.copy: Legends unite! Madonna and Kylie Minogue have a brand new entry in the UK Top 10 with 'Love Sensation'. An iconic collaboration!
